Name: Mephibosheth, Son of Jonathan
Summary: Mephibosheth, son of Jonathan, was lame in both feet from a fall when he was five, on the day Saul and Jonathan died. David sought him out for Jonathan's sake, restored Saul's land to him, and set him to eat at the king's table continually. He is also called Merib-baal.
KeyStory: Mephibosheth, lame since childhood, ate at David's table for Jonathan's sake.
RelatedPeople: Jonathan; King David; Ziba; Micha, Son of Mephibosheth
LifeLesson: Covenant kindness seeks out the lame and forgotten and seats them at the table.
